summary: The king expresses a desire in words, and Yahweh grants it. Psalm 21 supplies the only biblical instance of the noun.

senses.definition: The request made by the king’s lips stands parallel to the desire of his heart. The following lines give an example: he asked for life, and Yahweh gave it to him.

parallels.note: The desire of his heart is given, and the request of his lips is granted.

note: The corresponding Akkadian noun supports “request”. Akkadian š alone does not resolve the older sibilant. The Persian royal name Artaxerxes and the names beginning אשׂר have a different formation.
